title: The Legacy of Heavenly Fate
next_chapter_hook: At the moment Chen Ji inherited all his father's legacy, the Heavenly Eye that transcends the three realms finally erupted in rage—those who thought themselves Chess Players controlling the board are about to face a true reckoning.

text.content: The icy Spiritual Energy flowed down his throat like a clear spring, instantly soaking into Chen Ji's Brow Center. It was a purity he had never felt before—devoid of any impurities, carrying only a near-obsessive protective will. Su Qingyao's wisp of Spiritual Energy was actually the本源 of the「Frost Heart Art」she had nurtured in her Brow Center for a full ten years.\n\nHowever, in the next instant, another warm force surged from the Tianji Record Fragment over his chest, intersecting with that icy Spiritual Energy. The two vastly different energies collided within his Mental Sea, stirring waves of profound ripples—the inheritance seal that Chen Tianming had guarded for hundreds of years with his remnant soul was now completely loosening.

dialogue.content:
「You've come.」

The aged yet familiar voice rang from the Void. Chen Tianming's remnant soul slowly coalesced from the light of the Tianji Record, his form even more illusory than before, as if a gust of wind could scatter him. But those eyes remained deep as an abyss, gazing at Chen Ji with full of relief and anticipation.

「The Su girl's wisp of Frost Heart Art本源 actually helped you—it cleared your last barrier to inheritance.」 Chen Tianming smiled faintly, 「From today onward, you are the true master of this Tianji Record.」

text.content: Before the words finished, the suspended fragmented key suddenly burst forth with dazzling golden light. Chen Ji felt his chest grow hot as countless information flooded into his Mental Sea like a flood—the complete layout that Chen Tianming had meticulously organized over hundreds of years: the true depths of the three major Sects, the hidden weaknesses of the Demonic Path Holy Sect, the entry incantations for the Ancient Forbidden Land, and... a shocking secret he had never imagined.\n\n「This key,」 Chen Tianming's voice echoed in Chen Ji's mind, 「its true purpose is not sealing.」

dialogue.content:
「It is both seal and exit.」

Chen Tianming's voice carried a touch of vicissitudes: 「During ancient times, Heavenly Dao collapsed, the barriers between the three realms shattered. Countless vengeful spirits and monsters flooded into the mortal world, bringing catastrophe. The cultivators of that era joined hands, forging this key with Heavenly Fate, attempting to rebuild order.」

He paused, his gaze profound: 「However, they discovered that mere sealing could not eradicate the calamity—those things that were sealed would eventually break free. Thus they left this dual design... the seal is the lock, while the exit is the true liberation.」

text.content:
Chen Ji gazed at the golden-flowing key in his hand, finally understanding the true meaning of his father's centuries-long layout—he was not merely sealing something, but weaving a massive net encompassing the three realms.

「So the three major Sects' mutual destruction, the Demonic Path invasion, the opening of the Ancient Forbidden Land... were all intentionally provoked by you?」 Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly.

「Only chaos can allow true strong ones to stand out.」 Chen Tianming's voice was calm as still water, 「What I wanted was not an inheritor, but a Chess Player capable of controlling this entire game.」

Chen Tianming's form began to grow even more illusory, light thread by thread leaking from his contours. He raised his phantom palm, lightly tapping Chen Ji's Brow Center.

「The final step of inheritance requires you to make a promise.」 His voice seemed to come from the utmost distance, 「This promise will become the bridge between you and this key—do you wish to inherit my legacy and bear the full weight of the Heavenly Fate Key?」

Chen Tianming's eyes carried undeniable authority, yet deep within flickered a father's tenderness toward his son.

choice.prompt: Chen Tianming's remnant soul is about to dissipate. Chen Ji must make his promise at the final moment. He chooses:

choices.description: Promise to inherit his father's centuries-long plan and completely shatter the Heavenly Eye's conspiracy. This path means becoming the new Chess Player, bearing the heavy burden of the three realms' fate alone.
choices.risk_hint: Bearing the three realms' fate alone comes with a heavy price

text.content:
「I inherit.」

Chen Ji knelt on both knees, accepting his father's inheritance in the most solemn manner. Golden light erupted from the key, pouring into his Brow Center—that was all of Chen Tianming's accumulated insights, layouts, and secrets from hundreds of years.

「Good.」 Chen Tianming's voice carried relief, 「From now on, you are the new Chess Player. The Heavenly Eye, fate's backlash, the burden of the three realms... all shall be borne by you alone.」

choices.description: Promise to protect his sister Chen Nian's safety no matter what happens. This is his most sincere vow to protect his missing family member.
choices.risk_hint: His sister becomes a convergence point of fate, potentially vulnerable to entanglement

text.content:
「I will protect Xiaonian.」

Chen Ji's voice was firm, every word resolute. Chen Tianming's form trembled slightly, and tears actually glistened in those aged eyes.

「Good... good child.」 Chen Tianming's voice trembled, 「Xiaonian... she wasn't taken away. I deliberately hid her. She is the true core of the Heavenly Fate Key—only she can open that door.」

choices.description: Promise to slaughter all the forces that once schemed against the Chen family. This is a dark yet satisfying path of revenge, one that will make enemies pay the most brutal price.
choices.risk_hint: Hatred blinds the eyes, potentially falling into greater danger

text.content:
「I will make all who schemed against us pay the price.」

Chen Ji's voice was cold as iron, devoid of any warmth. A flicker of worry crossed Chen Tianming's eyes, yet he ultimately said nothing.

「Revenge is a double-edged sword.」 He sighed, 「It can make you go further, but it can also make you fall into the abyss. Remember, revenge is not the purpose—protection is.」

The instant the three promises transformed into golden light and merged into the key, Chen Tianming's remnant soul suddenly burst forth with its final radiance. His form began to dissolve inch by inch from the feet upward, turning into countless golden specks of light.

「Ji'er, your father has one last thing to tell you.」 Chen Tianming's voice echoed within the light, carrying undeniable authority, 「Regarding your sister Xiaonian—she was not taken by the Holy Sect, but sealed away by your father's own hands in an absolutely secret location.」

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

dialogue.content:
「Xiaonian is the「Heavenly Fate Lock Key」—she is the only existence that can interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight.」

Chen Tianming's voice grew increasingly faint: 「Back then, your father divined the Heavenly Secrets and discovered that your fate would inevitably clash with the Heavenly Eye. Xiaonian's existence... can shield you from the Heavenly Secrets' scrutiny, allowing you to hide outside of fate at crucial moments.」

His form had become nearly transparent: 「She is currently sealed at the「Three Realms Convergence Point」—the only place that can isolate the Heavenly Eye's perception. When you are ready, go find her...」

text.content:
「Father!」 Chen Ji reached out to grasp that dissipating form, yet only touched emptiness.

A relieved smile appeared on Chen Tianming's face: 「Don't be sad, your father has waited for this day for a very long time. Being able to witness you grow to this point, your father has no regrets.」

His voice grew softer: 「From now on, all the mysteries of the Tianji Record are in your hands. Your father believes you will walk a path even more glorious than your father's...」

Before the words finished, Chen Tianming's remnant soul finally dissipated completely, transforming into a soaring golden pillar of light that shot directly toward the deepest part of the heavens.

The light pillar pierced through layers of the Void, ultimately transforming into an eternal barrier at the convergence point of the three realms. That was Chen Tianming's soul's final resting place—he would use himself as the lock, sealing that dangerous node connecting the three realms.

At the same time, Chen Ji felt an intense tremor from the Tianji Record over his chest. Looking down, he saw those fragmented pages completing at a visible rate—each page bearing Chen Tianming's wisdom and memories.

When the final page completed, the entire Tianji Record erupted with unprecedented radiance, then slowly sank into Chen Ji's Brow Center, completely merging with his divine consciousness.

Chen Ji closed his eyes, feeling that unprecedented power flowing through his body. He could clearly perceive the location of the Three Realms Convergence Point, perceive his sealed sister's existence, and even perceive the fate threads of countless pieces on the chessboard spanning the three realms.

「Father...」 he murmured softly, and when he opened his eyes, moisture already glistened at their corners.

But in the next instant, his gaze turned cold and sharp once more. Though his father had dissipated, the chess game he left behind had just begun. And Chen Ji would become this game's new master.

choice.prompt: The instant inheritance completed, Chen Ji felt gazes from all directions watching him—the Heavenly Eye had begun to grow vigilant. He must decide how to respond to this incoming storm:

choices.description: Use his sister Xiaonian's「Heavenly Fate Lock Key」ability to completely conceal his aura, continue laying plans in the shadows. Let enemies believe he is still thattrash Outer Disciple/Servant.

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath,收敛 all his aura to the extreme. The complete Tianji Record vibrated slightly within his Mental Sea, actively releasing a hazy glow that completely concealed his existence.

「Good.」 He sneered in his heart, 「If Father could play the pig to eat the tiger for hundreds of years, why can't I?」

From now on, the world would have one more unknown Chess Player.

choices.description: Utilize newly acquired abilities to proactively demonstrate strength to the world, intimidating the minions. Declare the birth of the new Chess Player with absolute dominance.
choices.risk_hint: Premature exposure triggers the Heavenly Eye's full suppression

text.content:
Chen Ji slowly rose, his aura around him suddenly transforming. That genius aura he had deliberately suppressed erupted like a volcano, instantly enveloping the entire space.

「From today onward,」 his voice was calm yet carried undeniable authority, 「the entire world shall remember my name—Chen Ji.」

Su Qingyao widened her eyes, her face full of disbelief. This disciple brother she had always thought problematic, at this moment displayed a momentum that faintly showed signs of surpassing her Master.

choices.description: Contact allies such as Ye Qing at the first opportunity to share intelligence, turning enemies of enemies into the most steadfast companions. Weave a tighter alliance network.

text.content:
Chen Ji closed his eyes, establishing contact with Ye Qing far in the Demonic Path through the Tianji Record. A blurry image transmitted into the other's Mental Sea—those were truth fragments about the Heavenly Eye, and the possibility of cooperation.

After a moment, Ye Qing's reply came: 「Interesting, it seems we are all manipulated pieces. Since that's the case...」

Her voice carried a playful tone: 「Why don't we flip this chessboard together?」

After the light pillar dissipated, the cave returned to silence. Su Qingyao stared at Chen Ji in a daze, her eyes full of shock and complexity. The wisp of Frost Heart Art she had personally infused was currently producing a wondrous resonance with some force within Chen Ji's body.

「Disciple brother, you...」 Her voice trembled slightly, 「Who exactly are you?」

Chen Ji turned to look at her, the corner of his lips lifting into a meaningful smile: 「Didn't Sister say you already knew I had problems? Now the answer stands before you—do you dare accept it?」

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao took a deep breath, a flicker of struggle passing through her gaze, ultimately transforming into determination: 「The person Su Qingyao has acknowledged never asks about their origins. Everything you've revealed today indeed exceeds my imagination...」

Her voice trembled slightly, yet she did not retreat: 「But this is also the truth I have waited for all this time. From now on, no matter where you go, Su Qingyao wishes to stand shoulder to shoulder with you.」

Chen Ji gazed at this confidante who had come infinitely close to the truth three times, an indescribable emotion surging in his heart.

text.content:
However, at this moment, Chen Ji's Brow Center abruptly jumped. The complete Tianji Record violently trembled within his Mental Sea, a piece of information beyond perception exploded like thunder—それは来自天道之眼的震怒。

A vast pressure like the sea pressed down from the Void, and Chen Ji felt all his body hairs stand on end. For the first time he sensed that existence beyond the three realms so clearly—it was no longer a vague gaze hidden within fate's depths, but truly turning its gaze upon him.

「Found you.」

That voice seemed to ring from all directions simultaneously, devoid of any emotion, yet it made Chen Ji's very soul tremble.

Su Qingyao's complexion instantly turned ashen. Though she could not sense the Heavenly Eye's pressure, she could clearly see Chen Ji's suddenly rigid body.

「Chen Ji!」 She cried out, her hands tightly gripping his shoulders.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the agitation in his heart. A cold light flickered in his eyes, then calm returned.

「It's coming.」 He said softly, yet the corner of his lips lifted into a dangerous arc, 「Seems my debut has alarmed certain old friends earlier than expected.」

On fate's chessboard, the game between the Chess Player and the Heavenly Eye officially begins.
